title: dryopteris straminea
intro: Dryopteris straminea, commonly known as the Striped Wood Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris straminea include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
